premises.text: Seniors using walkers face fall injuries from forgetting to engage brakes before sitting and from steep ramps/hills that make traditional walkers run away, with high treatment costs and lasting fear/quality-of-life loss
premises.evidence_span: steep ramps and forgetfulness is what causes walk-related fall injuries

premises.text: Smart walker uses pressure sensors, encoders, and accelerometers to perceive user intention and environment and automatically/gradually brake to reduce injury risk
premises.evidence_span: capable of perceiving user intention, the environment around us, and actuating appropriately to minimize the risk of injuries

premises.text: Go-to-market is licensing the technology to walker manufacturers for factory integration
premises.evidence_span: license it to walker manufacturers. They integrate it into their walkers as they leave the factory

domains.name: walker fall injuries from brakes and hills

value.text: Safeguard seniors from falls so they keep a higher quality of life instead of wheelchair dependence and fear
value.evidence_span: These features safeguard seniors from falls, leading them to a higher quality of life
